messages:
Tara: Dropped a prototype for a gutter-embedded legend — tiny controls inside the chart margin to save vertical space. Demo in staging. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Evan: visually tidy. Two quick nits: 1) controls feel cramped at 320px width, 2) hover area for open menu is tiny on touch.
Mira: Agree with Evan. For touch we should increase target hit area to 44px but keep visual footprint small (padding vs hit target).
Sam: Accessibility: legend must expose role=menu and aria-haspopup. When collapsed, the toggle button should read 'Series controls, collapsed'.
Leah: Microcopy suggestion for collapsed state tooltip: 'Series options: show/hide, smoothing, units, clip'. Keep it under 45 characters.
Tara: Thinking of making the gutter legend context-aware: show only top 3 series by current viewport; "more" reveals rest. That reduces clutter on dense charts.
Evan: Context-aware idea good but ensure determinism — sort by value desc so users don't see items jump around with tiny metric changes. Also visual indicator if omitted items exist ("+6 more").
Mira: Keyboard flow: Tab into gutter, arrow keys to move between series, Enter opens series menu, Space toggles visibility. When inside menu, Esc closes and returns focus to series item. Add aria-live announcement: 'Series menu opened, 6 options'.
Sam: Smoothing presets in menu: off | fast (EMA 0.3) | smooth (SMA 7) | preserve-peaks (SG 7, poly2). Show tiny hint text under preset explaining tradeoffs.
Leah: UX nit: show 'smoothed' micro-badge on series names only when active, hover reveals algorithm + window. For small screens collapse to a single 'S' badge with tooltip.
Tara: Units control: propose [auto | raw | rate/s | per-host]. Default auto. If user changes, persist per-dashboard (not global) and encode in URL so links preserve view.
Evan: Outlier handling: avoid silently switching to log scale. Proposal: default clip at 99.5th percentile and mark clipped points with a small hollow caret (⌃) and provide 'Expand' inline. If user clicks expand, temporarily remove clipping for that point or zoom to it.
Mira: A11y: clipped marker must be focusable and have aria-label 'Value clipped at display max. Press Enter to reveal raw value.' Also add live region update when clipping occurs: '3 points clipped on visible series'. Debounce to avoid floods.
Sam: CSV export shape: columns: timestamp, displayed_value, raw_value, is_clipped (true/false). Also include meta row at top with chart config: normalization, smoothing, clip_pct. Helps debugging.
Leah: Visual design: use a subtle outline for focused series in gutter; use tokens for band opacity so teams can tweak. Also ensure contrast ratios for badges meet AA when shown on dark charts.
Tara: Performance: rendering many gutter legends per page could be expensive. Use virtualized list + canvas badges for mass lists. Only compute smoothing previews for visible items.
Evan: Implementation detail: use pointer-events gating so hover on gutter doesn't steal drag events from main chart. If user mouses down on gutter, treat as legend interaction; if they drag vertically, forward event to chart.
Mira: Keyboard shortcuts idea: press "." to focus legend gutter; Shift+. to collapse/expand all. Document in keyboard help. Announce via live region: 'Legend focused'.
Sam: Backend note: for percentile clipping we should compute pctile in the query layer and return clipped_count in metrics payload. Frontend decides how to mark and expand.
Leah: ChartPreviewBot: can you post staging preview?
ChartPreviewBot: Preview available: https://staging.redwood.com/visuals/gutter-legend-2450 — snapshot ux-2450
Tara: assigning tasks: Evan for hit-target/touch behavior, Mira for keyboard/a11y text and live region debounce, Sam for export + API change, Leah for design tokens & contrast pass. I'll update prototype based on feedback. Thanks all!
